final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_difference FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS overall_avg_difference FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.patient_id, s.sex, s.avg_pt, s.avg_difference, s.avg_difference * 1.0 / a.overall_avg_difference AS ratio FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS a WHERE a.overall_avg_difference IS NOT NULL) SELECT sex, AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_difference), AVG(ratio) FROM step3 WHERE sex <> '' GROUP BY sex
